checks.explanation: Physical observations must differ and have a useful declared time separation.
This initial screen requires identical release and pipeline version.
Scientific screening requires full CWAVE/CBAND calibration data.
Source and calibration archive URLs and verified file identities are required.
Unknown active flag bits must be investigated.
Coordinate arithmetic check; this does not measure absolute alignment.
Both observations need common unflagged and calibrated support.
Engineering screening threshold across all common supported pixels; not equivalence of spectral response functions.
Native Gaia-anchored reference residuals meet the declared engineering policy. No fitted correction was applied.
Engineering registration and response diagnostics are available. Internal technical review and qualified external scientific assessment have not been completed.

limitations: Engineering feasibility screen only. No validated motion, photometry, or discovery.
Thresholds are provisional engineering choices, not NASA standards.
WCS reprojection does not establish reference-source alignment.

processing.uncertainty_note: Native variances retained in original FITS. No resampled variance/significance map is claimed; interpolation creates covariance.

citations: This publication makes use of data products from the Spectro-Photometer for the History of the Universe, Epoch of Reionization and Ices Explorer (SPHEREx), which is a joint project of the Jet Propulsion Laboratory and the California Institute of Technology, and is funded by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration.
This work has made use of data from the European Space Agency (ESA) mission Gaia, processed by the Gaia Data Processing and Analysis Consortium (DPAC).

registration.method: Gaia DR3 anchored, native-image integrated-Gaussian centroids; no fitted registration transform
limitations: Reference identity is independent of SPHEREx image processing. No astrometric correction was fitted.
Empirical Gaussian profiles are diagnostics, not an ePSF astrometric likelihood.
No formal positional uncertainties or absolute astrometric precision are claimed.
Catalogue positions use proper motion; sub-5 mas parallax is neglected for this arcsecond-scale check.
References outside the inspection region can constrain surrounding registration, but do not prove local distortions are absent.

background.note: Native valid pixels without SOURCE flag; background estimates can still contain diffuse astrophysical emission.

local_epsf.note: Nearest local ePSF zone. Positive-wing moments are descriptive only; no deconvolution or matching applied.

restrictions: Qualitative spatial inspection only; brightness variability and quantitative residuals are unsupported.
Wavelength responses differ; CWAVE/CBAND agreement is an engineering screen, not response-function equality.
ePSF calibration is a documented newer model applicable to QR2, not a change to original calibrated arrays.
Background and zodiacal model remain unmodified in displayed scientific arrays.
Pipeline HISTORY identities agree, but public calibration files do not expose those same UUIDs; association needs independent review.
Unflagged instrumental artifacts and source blending remain possible.

title: M101 / Pinwheel Galaxy
description: A small region around the galactic nucleus. Real near-infrared observations; independent scientific approval remains pending.
